variants.headline: Party names a new leader
variants.sub: Leadership of {party} has changed, with {new} the new leader.
variants.body:
The party {party} has a new leader: {new}. A change at the head of an organisation is a political fact; a change in its programme is a separate question. Readers considering {target} should not have to accept the second as a necessary consequence of the first.

New leader. Same need to ask questions. A fresh name can make a political organisation look like a new story, but readers need more than a portrait to judge it. Keep the attention on responsibility; a personality is a person, not a programme for the whole colony.

This paper approaches {target} without a verdict supplied by the fact of replacement. Leadership has changed; the merits of conduct and proposals require their own assessment on an adequate record. Readers deserve a clear story and a straight answer about responsibility.
